notes: POST /serving-layer/query returns { status, data }. The fixture nests AlertId, AlertType, Category, and RiskLevel under data.*.value.
This mock flattens those to alertId, alertType, category, and riskLevel so a fetch loop can read them. The nested value objects are omitted.
Vendor HTML was not reloaded. The path is the public client and the fixture. A bearer token is required.
